programs.title: Submarine
programs.desc: Craig Roberts stars in Richard Ayoade's comedy-drama as a teen finding love while navigating the trials of school and home life. With Sally Hawkins and Yasmin Paige.

programs.title: Wonder Park
programs.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jennifer Garner, Mila Kunis, John Oliver and Matthew Broderick. A girl's imaginary theme park comes to life when her mum goes to hospital.

programs.title: The Call of the Wild
programs.desc: Touching adventure with Harrison Ford, based on Jack London's classic novel. A big, friendly hound finds himself unwittingly travelling across late 19th-century North America.

programs.title: It Came from Outer Space
programs.desc: Richard Carlson stars as an astronomer who sees an alien craft land. But nobody believes him - until the cloning starts in Jack Arnold's science-fiction classic.
